name: Taucherdorf Planseecamp
beschreibung: The Planseecamp is set in the Taucherdorf in Tyrol's Zillertal valley at an altitude of around 900 metres. The holiday chalets are quietly nestled at the edge of the forest, just steps away from Lake Plansee. Guests can enjoy practical, well-equipped accommodation featuring direct lake access and an outdoor barbecue area. The scenic natural surroundings provide excellent opportunities for alpine hikes and peaceful walks.
